scope: complete public seven-animal Figure 4 evaluation input and prediction interface

data_release.acquisition: Existing complete files reauthenticated against publisher MD5 and local SHA256; no duplicate complete-file acquisition.
data_release.format: uncompressed little-endian MATLAB v5 numeric variables

author_interface.license: UCL Academic License; author code not vendored in this component

characteristic_frequency_metadata.logical_grouping: Nine contiguous 512-value animal blocks, as sliced by the pinned helper
characteristic_frequency_metadata.original_trial_metadata_join: All 512 values, including negative-infinity signs, match the corresponding author block for each animal 3 through 9 in both trials

observations: animal_X selects source decoder X; public evaluation uses animals 3 through 9
Measurement time is supplied in seconds; an hours docstring does not override the implementation and example
CF-assisted author output sorts columns; original-column identity must be retained even when CF values tie
The helper samples categorical counts and discards probabilities; expected-count metrics require access before sampling
Demo context padding is not independent evidence of the historical evaluation crop

equation_scorer.reporting_change: Accepted Fig4d per-MUA vector and separate Fig4b flattening; no universal scalar prerequisite. Historical TESTING.json pins remain historical.
equation_scorer.variance_ddof: explicit 0 or 1; historical author choice not recovered

remaining_scientific_gates: Original evaluation-code binding of the four unlabeled measurement-time columns
Paper-era waveform context/crop and exact independent reliability-mask provenance
Original non-evaluation training and development data access
Qualified author probability-output bridge and LNP comparison on the same complete panel
Historical variance convention, textual-summary reduction and undefined-value replay; defined Fig4b/Fig4d vectors do not require a universal scalar
Protected candidate execution, paired paper/data and paper/data/code delivery, and authorized authentic scientific runs
